name: Matching Appli de Deaichuu Shitemita
original_name: マッチングアプリで出会い厨してみた
source:
In order to get a girlfriend for the first time in his life, our protagonist downloaded the dating app "Mariees". 

And so, he starts the seven day free trial for the app. Will he be able to successfully meet a lovely girl within that timeframe...?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4960]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
为了找到人生中的第一次女朋友，我们的主角下载了约会应用程序“Mariees”。

因此，他开始了该应用程序的7天免费试用。在这段时间内，他能否顺利遇见一位可爱的女孩……？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4960]NovelGame[/url]]
